description.value: Amble Coffee is a specialty coffee shop and mobile truck tucked near the Vedder River, built around the philosophy of slowing down and connecting with nature. The 'Amble' name is intentional — it invites customers to linger over coffee or tea rather than rush. For touring cyclists finishing a ride along the Vedder, it offers a nature-adjacent café stop in Chilliwack.
